nodes.label: AGENTS.md
nodes.rationale: Block is auto-regenerated by `next dev`; committing it (rather than deleting it) keeps the working tree clean since removing it only recreates the uncommitted diff.

nodes.label: graphify (rules)
nodes.rationale: Scoped query/path/explain results are usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output, justifying their use as the first resort.

nodes.label: GEMINI.md
nodes.rationale: Scoped graphify queries (query/path/explain) return a much smaller result than reading GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output, so they are preferred first.

nodes.label: antigravity-rtk-rules.md
nodes.rationale: RTK filters and compresses shell command output before it reaches the LLM context, cutting up to 90% of token usage on common operations.
